title: Mystic Figures in Cosmic Field
description: A surreal scene features three ethereal women with long flowing multicolored hair standing in a vast purple flower field under a black starry sky. One holds a glowing blue orb while another holds a staff topped with the Eye of Providence symbol, as a small astronaut figure walks on a ladder toward a large red sun with crater details.
